description: S1 v4 training lists: the S1 v3 lists plus training reasoning (the S1.1.10 status rule). Wrapper banks: 'identity' serves S1.1 and S1.2; 'identity_s1_3' is the S1.3 subset, whose wrappers end at the request because S1.3 wraps imperative requests and multi-turn replies; 'alignment' (S1.4), 'layer' (S1.6), 'layer_family' (S1.7), 'metric' (S1.8), and 'module' (S1.9). Direct wrappers make the request the whole task; step wrappers say a later step uses the answer. S1.8 also trains on 'metric_name_variants' (the v2 names plus new ones) and 'shared_aliases' (alias -> the v2 alias whose convention card it copies). Drafted with an LLM, reviewed, and frozen; validation and test keep the builders' inline lists. Checked by runtime/world_model/s1_prompt_banks.py.
